episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Bonnie makes a new friend, Ash runs into an old friend, and a terrifying premonition begins to unfold!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: While Eevee deals with some unwanted attention, Team Rocket turns its attention to Squishy!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: There's trouble at the local Pokémon Center, but our heroes and Professor Sycamore are there to help!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: As our heroes continue their journey to Snowbelle City, they encounter a young Pokémon faced with the challenges of growing up!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: A nighttime campout brings some interesting adventures for our heroes' Pokémon!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Our heroes' friend Sanpei is showing them Ninja Village, his home, but its peace and tranquility is soon to be threatened!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: On the eve of the village festival, the fate of Ninja Village hangs in the balance!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Our heroes are in Couriway Town for Serena's next Pokémon Showcase, and her third Princess Key win is at stake!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Our heroes are visiting Terminus Cave with hopes of seeing new Pokémon, but they're not alone!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: A courageous rescue during our heroes' search for Squishy leaves one of their friends in danger!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: An expansive field of flowers provides our heroes with a beautiful setting to witness a blooming friendship!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Serena is invited to a dance party for Pokémon performers, and there are many surprises in store!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: A fierce battle between two powerful Pokémon is about much more than just who wins!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: As Team Flare continues to advance Operation Z, they get help from an unexpected source!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Traversing a vast expanse of parched land, our heroes discover a small group of dedicated individuals in need!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: It's Pokémon Showcase time for Serena, and winning her third Princess Key is on the line!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Our heroes are about to take part in an exciting celebration, but the guest of honor is not happy!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Our heroes plan to visit a gem exhibition - but they run into a mystery instead!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: The Pokémon Showcase Master Class is under way and Serena is competing with friends and rivals galore!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: The Pokémon Showcase Master Class is in full swing and Serena's quest to become Kalos Queen is shifting into high gear!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Bonnie has been looking for someone to take care of her big brother, but what will happen when she finds that someone?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: While Ash battles a fever, another Trainer comes along to challenge him to a Pokémon battle!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Ash and Greninja have displayed some amazing and mysterious traits in battle, and Clemont wants to find out why!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Team Rocket is still after Pikachu, but a shy, rare Pokémon is getting in their way!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: Ash wants to learn more about what happens when he and Greninja merge during battle, and the Champion Diantha is the right person to help!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: During our heroes' final leg of their journey to Snowbelle City, a chance meeting with an old friend and rival gives Ash a surprising battle opportunity!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 27
episodes_data.description: The time for Ash's Snowbelle City Gym battle is here, and his eighth Gym badge hangs in the balance!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 28
episodes_data.description: Following Ash's defeat at the Snowbelle Gym, some not-so-quiet introspection turns into some real inspiration!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 29
episodes_data.description: Ash is back at the Snowbelle City Gym for a rematch, but will Gym Leader Wulfric feel the heat?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: A visit to the home of friends confronts our heroes with a most unusual group of challenges!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 31
episodes_data.description: Clemont has invited the rest of our heroes to experience one of his true passions, while a certain group of uninvited guests are along for the ride!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: The Kalos League is just getting underway, and the battle temperature is already turned way up!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: The Kalos League rages on toward the semifinals, and the red-hot battling never ceases to excite and amaze!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: The semifinals of the Kalos League have arrived, bringing two intense battles!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 35
episodes_data.description: As the Kalos League semifinal round continues between Ash and Sawyer, the audience witnesses a rivalry few have ever experienced!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 37
episodes_data.description: It's time for the Kalos League finals and it's Ash versus Alain in their much anticipated battle!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 38
episodes_data.description: The final round of the Kalos League is in high gear and surprises are in abundance; from the first second to the very last!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 39
episodes_data.description: Lysandre and Team Flare are attempting to take over Lumiose City and the world and our heroes are in the middle of the chaos!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 40
episodes_data.description: Lumiose City is on the verge of ruin, but our heroes and their friends are not about to stand by and do nothing!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 41
episodes_data.description: As Ash and the gang are separated each one is trying to help others in different ways.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 42
episodes_data.description: The fate of Chespie and the world rests in the hands of an extraordinarily powerful group of friends and allies!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 43
episodes_data.description: The moment of truth has arrived, as our heroes and their friends must face the final challenge that will decide the fate of the world!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 44
episodes_data.description: The Lumiose City Gym is still being repaired, but a battle challenge from a young Trainer is just the thing to get everyone and everything up and running!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 45
episodes_data.description: Our heroes are busy planning their futures, but one is having more trouble planning than the others!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 46
episodes_data.description: As our heroes prepare to go their separate ways, they face the return of a danger that wasn't quite defeated!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 47
episodes_data.description: Our heroes are going their separate ways, and it's time for goodbyes, fond memories, and eyes to the future!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 19 XYZ Season 19 Episode 48
episodes_data.description: A trip to some newly discovered ruins in Kalos reveals a rich history of compassion and caring from three Legendary Pokémon!
